segments.text: Hi friends, over the past 5 years, my team and I have measured almost everything there is to measure, but my personal experiments have always had one major limitation. Me. Everything we've done has come from a single [music] male subject. Women experience dramatically different biological changes across every month, [music] every life stage, and almost every system of the body. So, this year, we're beginning our most ambitious experiment yet.

Kate Tollo is about to become the most measured female in history. That's an awkward wave. She's going to spend the next several months doing exactly the same thing every day while we measure hundreds of biomarkers across every phase of her menstrual cycle. In summary, this experiment will cover 1,900 biomarkers, 16 biological systems, 14.8 million data points, over 50 different devices, the annual cost, $2.6 million.
